parts.t: Explore City of Mission land use plans, Official Community Plan (OCP) maps, and zoning updates to understand where future growth, redevelopment, and new housing are planned. These community plans help buyers, sellers, and investors track density changes, development corridors, and upcoming neighbourhood improvements across Cedar Valley, Downtown Mission, Silverdale, and Stave Heights. Need help understanding how these changes may impact your property value or investment strategy? Contact Jared Gibbons for local insight and personalized guidance.

lines.text: The Cedar Valley Local Area Plan and Cedar Valley Engineering Plan provide detailed guidance for the future development of the Cedar Valley community. These plans are based on the principles of sustainability addressing the need to balance economic, environmental and social needs in creating a complete and resilient community.

The document is designed as an action plan to stimulate both private and public investment and improve the economics of the downtown. Some of the actions can be undertaken immediately, while others will occur over time.

The Silverdale Central Neighbourhood Plan was undertaken to realize the vision of an urban destination mixed-use neighbourhood as outlined within Mission’s Official Community Plan within the Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area (SCPA).

The Stave Heights Neighbourhood Plan provides a clear guide for new development, public investment, and an opportunity for a diversity of housing within the environmentally sensitive hillside landscape with connecting trails, park, and protected natural lands that integrate with the surrounding community.

parts.t: Mission offers an exceptional Fraser Valley lifestyle combining small-town charm, outdoor recreation, and surprising affordability compared to Metro Vancouver. This scenic community attracts diverse buyers from young families to retirees seeking natural beauty, genuine community connections, and quality of life without urban stress. Residents love the stunning mountain and river views, access to hiking, water sports, and year-round outdoor activities literally minutes from home.

Downtown Mission features heritage character with local shops, cafes, and restaurants creating a walkable village atmosphere where people know their nneighbours.The city provides excellent schools, modern recreation facilities, and community programs while maintaining reasonable housing costs across all property types. Improved Highway 7 makes commuting to Abbotsford, Maple Ridge, or even Vancouver increasingly practical for those willing to travel. Whether you're relocating for lifestyle or seeking value, Mission delivers both. Interested in what Mission offers? Reach out for current listings and recent sales throughout the community.
